data.name: Sharveer
data.long_meaning: The name Sharveer is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Shar and Veer. Shar means the king of the gods and Veer means the brave one. It is a powerful name that represents the supreme power of the gods and the bravery of an individual.

It is a name that is believed to bestow strength, power, and intelligence on an individual. It is a name that inspires loyalty and courage, and is often given to children who are destined to lead.
